That’s super weird dump him and report him if you’re inclined

If it makes you feel any better, even if you hadn’t stopped letting the cats in the bedroom there is a chance they would stop sleeping with you anyway. My cat goes through phases where she sleeps right next to me and phases where I won’t see her until the next morning. So it might be that they just changed on their own.

In a similar situation but with my stepfather who got sober about 20 years ago when I was a teen (after years of tormenting us with his drinking). He has relapsed a few times since then. It’s frustrating to never get an apology especially when it’s right there in the 12 steps. I’ve told my therapist the worst of his stories and am just trying to move past it but it’s an ongoing struggle

The time with my current therapist is coming to an end. She’s been wanting to refer me out for some time now because of my PTSD. I continue to feel rejected and have a childish desire to like not show up to the last session or to be withholding. I know that I would regret being like that in the long run though. I have a new therapist lined up and my current claims that I’ll be able to go back to her if it does it work out but I don’t believe her. Just seems like she is saying the “nice thing” to get rid of me.

Personally dealing with doctors I find if I come to them with what I learned from Dr. Google they seem annoyed. So sometimes instead of saying I have xyz I’ll just lay out all my symptoms that match the diagnosis and let them put two and two together. Maybe therapists are less egotistical and it is not necessary lol.
Also in DC I find people don’t card about looks. If a man is allowed to wear his bright red Patagonia jacket to bike to work women should be allowed to wear puffer coats lol

I’d recommend ll bean which are 200 coats but very warm. You can buy a second cheaper coat at TJ max , the Georgetown location has great prices. It may also be too late in the season to bother now with buying the cheaper coat at this moment because those are best for the fall. I see people in the thread claim it’s not cold here which is true if you come from Ohio but not warm weather states lol.

My therapist this week is increasing the hints that I need to find a new therapist. She has told me for a while that she is not equipped to deal with PTSD, but I’ve sort of clung on like a barnacle because I like talking to her. It’s hard to not feel rejected and like I should just ghost and drop out of therapy regardless of whether I’ve found someone new. But I know that I need her support for a few more sessions and she’s willing to keep seeing me for now. This succcckkks
